info.title: Accord Analytics API
info.description: Read API over the indexed Accord treasury data. This file is the contract for the HTTP endpoints: `cargo test -p accord-analytics-api openapi` fails whenever it drifts from the router or the parameter validation in `analytics-api/src/main.rs`. Written by hand; see docs/ANALYTICS_API.md.

200.description: The datastore answered within two seconds.

get.description: Per-dependency health used by the public status page. The overall status is `operational`, `degraded` or `outage`.

200.description: The service is operational or degraded.

get.description: Request, latency, rate-limit, cache and alert metrics in the Prometheus text format.

post.description: See the GraphQL section of docs/ANALYTICS_API.md.

200.description: A GraphQL response; execution errors are reported in `errors`.

400.description: The request was rejected by a safeguard.

429.description: The client exceeded its rate limit. See the `Retry-After` header.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the client may retry.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of items to skip.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort direction.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by proposal status; `all` disables the filter.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Filter by proposal category; `all` disables the filter.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of the proposer address.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Filter by token symbol, for example XLM or USDC.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound, an ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound, an ISO 8601 date or date-time, not before startDate.

parameters.name: contractId
parameters.description: Narrow the response to one indexed contract; must be one of CONTRACT_IDS.

parameters.name: network
parameters.description: Narrow the response to one network; must be one of NETWORKS.

400.description: A query parameter is invalid or unsupported.

429.description: The client exceeded its rate limit. See the `Retry-After` header.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the client may retry.

500.description: The datastore could not be queried.
